name: task-tracker
description: Example task tracker built with Zebric and custom behaviors

scripts.mcp: zebric-mcp-server --connect http://127.0.0.1:3000 --application-name task_tracker --credential-env TASK_TRACKER_API_KEY --allow-mutation task_tracker_create_task --allow-mutation task_tracker_update_task --allow-mutation task_tracker_set_task_status --allow-mutation task_tracker_delete_task
scripts.build: echo 'No build step needed - runtime engine'
